entries.title: Rewriting a shifted piecewise signal
entries.description: substitute the shifted argument into each branch and adjust the corresponding time intervals.

entries.title: Interpreting time shifting physically
entries.description: connect a time shift to earlier or later arrival of the same waveform.

entries.title: Interpreting time scaling
entries.description: understand that scaling changes how quickly a signal unfolds in time rather than when it begins.

entries.title: Compressing a signal in time
entries.description: apply $x(at)$ with $a>1$ and interpret it as making the signal run faster.

entries.title: Expanding a signal in time
entries.description: apply $x(t/a)$ with $a>1$ and interpret it as making the signal run slower.
